summary: All TDD-anchor tests present and well-formed: drop path, new-shape no-op (asserts index UNCHANGED, not just present — catches accidental drop+recreate), fresh-DB no-op + never-throws, Mongo-fault swallow (real dead-address factory, not a mock), and the fan-out coexist/collide proofs in both the runner IT and the task-owned FunnelIndexesIT (the latter against the real auto-index-created shape). funnelsCollectionHasExpectedIndexes updated to assert triggerType='on_start'. Tests assert real Mongo state via Testcontainers (correct test type — no over-mocking). Boot-ordering fix proven by the live boot smoke (not replayable in an IT). One resource-hygiene fix applied.

findings.title: MongoClient leaked in reconciliationNeverThrowsOnMongoFault
findings.detail: The fault test created a MongoClient that was never closed. Wrapped in try-with-resources so the client is closed after the assertion.

findings.title: Partial overlap between runner-IT and FunnelIndexesIT coexist/collide tests
findings.detail: twoActiveEventFunnelsCoexistAfterMigration (runner IT, manually-installed shape) overlaps with twoActiveEventFunnelsWithSameTriggerValueCoexist (FunnelIndexesIT, real auto-index shape). They exercise subtly different shapes (manual vs annotation-driven), and the task explicitly sanctions the proof living in the FunnelIndexesIT sibling. Each earns its place; kept as-is.
